title: Pine Lake Marina
specs: Only marina on Pine Lake offering watersport packages
New model luxury tritoons with additional center toon for stability
Renter must be at least 21 years old and present valid driver's license
Captains must be at least 18 years old, present valid driver's license, and participate in orientation
Prior boating experience required for 26' Tritoon and Ski Boat
Strict weight capacity limits: 1200 lbs or 6 people on 20' pontoons and ski boats; 1400 lbs or 10 people on 20' tritoons; 2000 lbs or 14 people on 26' tritoons
Maximum 2 appointed Captains per rental; additional Captains cost $20 each
includes: Boat safety gear and life jackets included
Bluetooth stereo and USB charger on boats
gap: Exact duration options beyond 2 hour minimum not stated
blurb: Guests rent boats such as pontoons, tritoons, and ski boats to use on Pine Lake only. Watersport tow packages and water toys like tubes, skis, wakeboards, and kneeboards are available. Rentals include safety gear and life jackets, and guests drive their own boats after orientation.
extraNote: Payment is non-refundable; bookings are non-refundable · Optional cancellation protection available at booking through third-party · Reschedule allowed up to 72 hours before rental with $20 fee · No show policy effective 30 minutes after scheduled departure · Boats go out rain or shine; bimini covers provide partial rain protection · Management may issue rainchecks if weather too dangerous at departure time, valid for 1 year · No rainchecks or refunds for early returns due to weather · Pine Lake Marina at 908 Pine Lake Avenue, La Porte, IN · Mid-May through October
